notes.title: Price Change
notes.notes:
Dear Adventurers,

from the depths of our hearts, we want to extend our warmest gratitude to each and every one of you who have embarked on this epic journey in the world of Baalzebub. Your unwavering support, invaluable feedback, and infectious passion for our game have not gone unnoticed.

In celebration of our amazing community and to bring even more heroes into our realm, we're thrilled to announce that Baalzebub will soon be completely free of charge!

This isn't just a promotional stint, but a gesture of our profound appreciation. Whether you've battled the fiercest of monsters or shared memorable tales with fellow travelers, we want everyone to experience the magic without any barriers.

Thank you once again for being the lifeblood of Baalzebub. Your tales of valor, camaraderie, and adventures have only just begun. We look forward to seeing all that you will achieve in the chapters ahead!

With utmost gratitude,

The Baalzebub Team

notes.title: New keyboard shortcuts!
notes.notes:
Now you can open/close the inventory using the 'I' button, 
switch 'A'rmor, 'F'ood and 'M'agic,
and use the food items immediately using the slot number keys 1..n
